title: GEO Audit request
description: What to audit. The tier (Quick / Full) is defined by the purchased offering, not by a field.

subject.description: Name of the brand, token, product, protocol or person to audit.

subjectType.description: Kind of subject; selects question templates.

category.description: Market category used in unbranded discovery questions, e.g. "AI agent launchpads".

aliases.description: Alternative spellings and tickers. "$TICKER" also matches "TICKER".

domains.description: Own domains for the citation metric; subdomains count.

competitors.description: Competitors for share of voice and comparison questions. If omitted, they are extracted from answers.

facts.description: Canonical facts used to detect misrepresentation.

contractAddress.description: Token contract address (tokens only); adds a trust question.

customQueries.description: Extra questions to ask; language is detected by Cyrillic characters.
